Support the project

IkaTracker is an independent project — no ads, no sponsors. I build and maintain it in my spare time, and I pay for the servers out of my own pocket. If you find it useful, there are plenty of ways to help out, some of them cost nothing at all.

Where the money goes

VPS ~ $20/month
Domain ~ $15/year
…and lots of coffee ∞

Become a scraper

Scraping is centralized and automated, so manual contributions are not needed. Drop by our Discord to stay updated or to suggest new servers.
